content: Hey love, good morning! I was thinking about you all night. How did you sleep?
Morning! I didn't sleep great, but seeing your message makes it better. How's the rig today?
It's the same as always, loud and busy. But knowing you care makes the days brighter. I can't wait for us to finally meet in person.
I really hope so. It's been such a tough week. Talking to you helps so much.
You're my rock. Sometimes I can't believe how lucky I am to have you in my life. I wish I could just hop on a plane tonight.
I wish that too. It's been so long since I've felt this connected to someone.
You give me hope every day. Listen, there's something I want to talk to you about, but I've been nervous to say it.
What is it? You know you can tell me anything.

Thank you. So, my company just notified me that there's a mandatory processing fee before I can schedule my leave. I really wanted to surprise you and come home, but I'm stuck out here until it's paid.
Oh no, that sounds stressful. Is there anything I can do to help?
I hate even asking, but I can't access my accounts from the rig due to security restrictions. If you could help me cover the fee, I'll pay you back as soon as I'm back onshore. I promise.
How much is it? And how do I send it to you?
It's $1,200. The company accepts payments through Wise. I can send you the account details if you're comfortable with that. I'll keep every receipt and return every cent.
Let me check my accounts. I think I can manage it. Just send me the info.

Thank you, love. I can't express how much this means to me. Here are the Wise account details: Account name - Mark Stevens; Routing number - 021000021; Account number - 987654321. Just let me know when it's done.
Okay, I'm filling out the transfer now. Do you need a confirmation or anything?
If you could send me a screenshot once it's processed, that would be perfect. I'm so grateful for you, most people wouldn't do this, but you're special.
Of course. You mean a lot to me. I just want you home safe.
I will be, thanks to you. I promise I'll make this up to you, every single day when I'm finally there. Please don't worry, everything is legitimate and secure.
Alright, it's sent. Sending you the screenshot now.
Got it! Thank you so much, sweetheart. You have no idea how much this helps. You truly have my heart.
